intro: Finn.no yielded a fresh crop of finance roles today, led by several postings from the past 24 hours. Bindeleddet (bindeleddet.no/jobs/) returned HTTP 404 and could not be fetched; nu.nhhs.no/en/jobs/ loaded but its content was fully truncated by the fetch tool, so both sources return no listings.
